description: Use this when the user asks why a campaign scores as it does or what it really pays: ClippingAlpha's analytics for one campaign. The Alpha Score and tier, the four factor verdicts (Pay, Budget, Payout rules, Approval, plus payout record or content when they matter) with the adjustments that moved the score, what one clip pays at 10K, 50K and 100K views after caps, minimums and platform fees, the budget runway (dollars left and the run-out forecast when it falls within 90 days) and how it compares with similar live campaigns. Read only.

campaign.description: The campaign as brand/series (for example lovable/clipping), its clippingalpha.com page URL, or its numeric campaignId from another tool.
